next.reason: Identifier-1 is kept: §2023:14.9.39.3 SR1 'shall reference a data item of class index or an integer data item'. Identifier-2 narrows: §2023:14.9.39.3 SR2 'shall reference a data item of class index'. The 1985 integer sender is now written as arithmetic-expression-1 (§2023:14.9.39.2), which no syntax rule requires to be an integer. Instead §2023:14.9.39.4 GR2 sets EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT 'If the value of arithmetic-expression-1 does not result in an integer'. A non-integer numeric sender, refused at compile time in 1985, compiles and raises a run-time exception condition (error mode c).
